parameters.query:
WITH bloqueos AS (
    SELECT
        a.pid,
        a.usename,
        a.query,
        l.locktype,
        l.mode,
        EXTRACT(
            EPOCH FROM (NOW() - a.query_start)
        ) AS segundos
    FROM pg_locks l
    JOIN pg_stat_activity a
        ON l.pid = a.pid
    WHERE l.granted = false
      AND a.state = 'active'
      AND NOW() - a.query_start > INTERVAL '30 seconds'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT pid)::int AS total_bloqueos,
    COALESCE(MAX(segundos), 0)::numeric(10,2)
        AS segundos_maximos,
    COALESCE(
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pid::text, ', '),
        'Ninguno'
    ) AS procesos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pid) > 0 AS alerta_d5
FROM bloqueos;
